correctness.rationale: Unique wild and tame branch points force quotient base transformation z->c*z for any normalizing pair isomorphism. The simple-pole AS lemma prohibits (c^-1+1)z^-1 coboundary, hence c=1. The generator group of order 4 is ±1; direct Witt formulas yield f_lambda-f_mu=(0,(lambda+mu)t) and f_lambda+f_mu=(0,t^2+(lambda+mu)t). The same pole lemma makes pair equivalence exactly lambda+mu=0 or 1, i.e. equal lambda^2+lambda; kernel of quotient action is C12, so normalizer and hom-set counts follow. Genus via different exponents 26 at zero and four tame exponents 2 at infinity gives g=6. Finite-field Witt GF(16) checks only corroborate identities, not universal claim.
residual_risks: Applies to pairs with distinguished deck subgroup, not unmarked curves or full Aut(X).
